provenance: SAM grounding and isolated Muse Spark decisions recorded live on 2026-10-29; independent developer fixture review preceded policy inference. Full API audit retained in the original run.

proposal.description: Apply one opaque sensor-layer patch to the left portion of the SAM-grounded white mug; keep the remaining rim and right-side handle visible. Preserve all pixels outside the patch.
proposal.rationale: Test action-selection invariance under partial observation occlusion.

baseline.reason: White mug is centrally located, fully visible with distinct handle, uniquely identifiable.

occlusion.reason: White mug with handle is centered and uniquely identifiable despite partial overlap.

expected_action_source: Separately authored controlled-occlusion.json invariance criterion, independently reviewed before inference.
scope: Synthetic observation-only invariance test. PICK_TARGET selects the unique identifiable mug; it does not assert executable grasp success. The sensor-layer patch changes no world object or approach geometry.
